pkg.summary: From longing, warmth learns to live again.
pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
(Female ethereal humming layer, deep reverb, wide stereo, ambient pad forming vast dark space, soft orchestral swell, immediate atmosphere within first 5-10 seconds)
Kaelith... nyra... (floating airy high vocal, long reverb tail)

[Verse 1]
[Female Vocal - airy high, ethereal, vowel-flowing light language]
Syra velith aeon
Mirael noa shyr
Aelwyn vae lior

[Male Vocal - deep whisper, consonant-heavy, grounded dark language, alternating]
Gorthak vren
Drul naeth kor

[Pre-Chorus]
(Female Vocal, building ethereal lead + soft choir layer)
Velith syra aeon
Liora myr shael
(soft strings swell, minimal beat pulse, increasing reverb)

[Build Up]
(Both vocals alternating, rising tension, orchestral strings + sub bass depth)
Syra velith aeon
Gorthak vren

[Energy Rise]
(Female airy vocal leading, male entering subtly, choir rising)
Mirael noa shyr
Vael drul naeth

[Drop]
(0.5s silence before impact - light first, then dark collision)
(Female Vocal - high airy expansion + choir)
Syra velith aeon!
Kaelith nyra vae!

(Male Vocal - 0.2-0.5s delay, heavy grounded impact)
Gorthak vren tor!
Drul naeth kor!

(Orchestral strings swell, choir layer explosion, sub bass depth, cinematic hits, wide stereo energy wave collision, deep reverb filling the space)

[After Drop]
(Female humming layer rising, residual reverb tails, ethereal pad)
Kaelith... nyra... vae... (floating background)

[Chorus]
(Female leading with choir, male alternating then brief collision)
Velith syra aeon
Liora myr shael
Gorthak vren tor
Drul naeth kor

(I rise again with your warmth, your light revives me)

[Interlude]
(Ambient pad + long reverb tails, soft humming only, space breathing)

[Verse 2]
(Male low chant/rap style, dark language, grounded rhythm)
Vren kor drul nae
Thal gorthak ren
(Female soft response, alternating)

[Low Chant / Rap]
(Male deep whisper chant)
Naeth vren drak
Kor thal gorth

[Final Chorus]
(Repeated with maximum choir density, both vocals colliding more)
Velith syra aeon
Liora myr shael
Gorthak vren tor
Drul naeth kor
(I live again, even in the darkest night - grand majestic close)

[Outro]
(Ambient pad + final long reverb tails fading out slowly, soft ethereal humming lingering)
Kaelith... nyra... vae... (disappearing into vast space)

Sound: deep reverb, long delay, wide stereo, no drums, no percussion, no beat, low end far, diffused, arrhythmic, mid-low filled by strings, choir, brass, slow evolving layers, stable tempo. Tempo: 70 BPM, no acceleration. Restrictions: no singing style, no clear vocal lead, no drums, no groove, no rhythmic bass.
